violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection. Observed no certified food manager on site at the start of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. Certified food manager arrived during inspection.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating, smoking, or drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection. Observed employee drinking from open beverage in kitchen during inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. EHS discussed proper eating and drinking in kitchen. Drink relocated to outside of food preparation area.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw beef above ready to drink yogurt in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. person in charge relocated raw beef next to beverages to prevent contamination.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: observed raw chicken above ground beef, raw beef above raw shell eggs in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). Person in charge arranged items by cook temperature to prevent contamination.

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: Non-Commercial Juice, Warning Label Not Pasteurized
violations.observation: Untreated juice packaged in the food establishment is not labeled with a proper warning statement. Observed packaged beverage made with freshly squeezed beet juice in freezer without warning label.
violations.corrective_action: Juice packaged in a food establishment, if not treated to attain a 5-log reduction of the most resistant microorganism of public health significance, shall be labeled with a warning notice that states 'WARNING: This product has not been pasteurized and, therefore, may contain harmful bacteria that can cause serious illness in children, the elderly, and persons with weakened immune systems'. Person in charge agreed to discontinue making beverage with freshly squeezed beets.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. Observed mouse droppings near baseboard of wall near freezer/walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. Please obtain pest control for treatment of mice and forward invoice to EHS within 10 days. ISTANBUL KITCHEN (Inspection Date: 10/19/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Plan & Specifications Submission - Remodeling, Change of Type, Change of Operation
violations.observation: The permit holder did not submit plans or specifications for remodeling/renovation, change in type of establishment leading to extensive menu change, and/or change in layout/equipment. Observed no amendment submitted for required addition of a mop sink. Facility is working with plumbing and health department to determine how and where to install mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: The permit applicant needs to submit the following documents to the Health Department for review and approval: amendment for addition of a mop sink.
